summary.en: Chinese AI startup known for long-context and reasoning. Latest Kimi K3 (2.8T params, 1M context) rivals Claude Opus — now open source.
summary.zh: 中国 AI 初创公司，擅长长上下文与推理。最新 Kimi K3（2.8万亿参数，100万上下文）性能对标 Claude Opus，已开源。

title.en: Moonshot AI API Key - Kimi K3 (2.8T Open Source, July 2026) | Get Model Key
title.zh: 月之暗面 API Key - Kimi K3 开源旗舰（2026年7月）| Get Model Key

description.en: Get Moonshot AI API key for Kimi K3 — 2.8 trillion parameter open-source model with 1M context, rivaling Claude Opus.
description.zh: 获取月之暗面 API Key，使用 Kimi K3：2.8万亿参数开源旗舰，100万上下文，性能对标 Claude Opus。

benefit.en: New users can usually receive about CNY 15 in starter credit, often with real-name verification required (subject to official policy).
benefit.zh: 新用户通常可获得约 15 元体验额度，一般需实名（具体以官方规则为准）。

notes.en: Excellent long-context handling, making it a strong option for long-document reading and webpage summarization in OpenClaw workflows.
notes.zh: 长文本处理能力突出；在 OpenClaw 中做长文档阅读、网页总结这类任务时，Kimi 通常是稳妥选择。

en: Moonshot AI (月之暗面) builds the Kimi family of models, known for long-context reasoning. Recent materials highlight Kimi K3 with very large parameter scale and up to about 1M context, described as open source.
The Open Platform at platform.moonshot.cn provides API keys and docs for integrating Kimi into apps and agent workflows.
getModelKey only points to Moonshot’s official key console. We do not sell or redistribute Moonshot API keys.
zh: 月之暗面（Moonshot AI）打造 Kimi 系列模型，擅长长上下文与推理。近期资料提到 Kimi K3 参数规模极大、上下文约可达百万级，并已开源（以官网为准）。
开放平台 platform.moonshot.cn 提供 API Key 与文档，便于把 Kimi 接入应用与智能体工作流。
getModelKey 只跳转到月之暗面官方 Key 控制台，不出售、不转发 API Key。

en: Go to https://platform.moonshot.cn/console/api-keys and sign in with a Moonshot account.
Create an API key in the console and save it offline immediately.
Use the key with Moonshot’s documented API base URL and model IDs.
Manage billing, quotas, and key rotation only inside the official platform.
zh: 打开 https://platform.moonshot.cn/console/api-keys ，使用月之暗面账号登录。
在控制台创建 API Key，并立即离线保存。
按官方文档的 API 地址与模型 ID 调用该 Key。
账单、额度与 Key 轮换请只在官方平台操作。

answer.en: A recent Moonshot flagship in the Kimi line, highlighted for long context and open-source release. Details change—check moonshot.cn and the platform docs.
answer.zh: Kimi 系列近期旗舰，强调长上下文与开源发布。细节以 moonshot.cn 与平台文档为准。

answer.en: Any starter credit depends on Moonshot’s current policy (often after real-name checks). Confirm in the official console—getModelKey does not quote live prices.
answer.zh: 体验额度以月之暗面当时政策为准（常需实名）。请在官方控制台确认；本站不提供实时报价。

question.zh: getModelKey 会提供月之暗面 Key 吗？

answer.en: No. Use only the official API keys page linked from this directory.
answer.zh: 不会。请只通过本站链到的官方 API Keys 页面自行创建。
